provenance.initial_source: Saved before-codec J/U already verified component-identical to XDF_full prefixes; verify again, never regenerate a decomposition

codec_rules: Require finite real float64 orthogonal U and exactly symmetric finite float64 J; do not orthogonalize or cast invalid input
For det<0 only, flip final U column; each original density projector unchanged
Existing scipy.linalg.schur(output=real), signed atan2 for each nonzero-subdiagonal 2x2 rotation block, pair -1 scalar blocks into pi planes
A=(Q B Q.T-(Q B Q.T).T)/2 removes recorded roundoff only; verify Schur/exponential/skew residuals <= existing1e-10; no complex-log fallback
Pack real skew upper triangles and symmetric J through existing ffsim util; unpack with df_tensors_from_params(real=True)

Require exact J/rank/frame-order preservation, U_out matches sign-gauged representative and original per-column density projectors within1e-10; raw U difference due only to recorded gauge is not a failure
Require reconstructed tensor max-entry and Frobenius residual <=1e-10*max(1,||g_before||F); fail rather than approximate silently
physical_rules: Original-g corrected kappa, scalar and frame order unchanged. Existing SectorCAR/rank_assessment on sector400 only. Compare each state to same original physical h/g/c. No Gaussian gate projection/full dense4096/controlled8192.

call_definition.saved_codec_load: one saved g/full-XDF/two-before-snapshots load in read-only fit env
call_definition.saved_initial_identity: per rank one J/U component comparison with original XDF_full prefix, including column signs
call_definition.corrected_codec: per rank one real-Schur/gauge/ffsim pack-unpack, frame residuals/projectors/J/tensor-fidelity checks; includes per-frame Schur/expm but no fit
call_definition.tensor_assessment: per rank/state one existing tensor reconstruction residual F/max/objective diagnostic; four states total
call_definition.snapshots_load: original h/g/c and four worker state exports loaded once for sector evaluator
call_definition.sector_context: one existing sparse sector CAR context
call_definition.physical_sector: one existing OF sparse physical Hamiltonian restricted then densified400
call_definition.sector_assessment: one existing rank_assessment per rank/state, raw CAR reconstruction, sector norm and unchanged numerical guard
call_definition.saved_sector_replay: per rank compare before norm with previously saved diagnostic scalar at existing1e-10 Ha allowance
call_definition.fidelity_and_budget_gate: per rank existing component_check of sector operators at1e-10, reported spectral norm of difference, and both states must satisfy unchanged norm+guard<=CA/8

execution_order: Separate explicit user permission after fixed SOURCE/input/call/STOP review; current preparation does not authorize science
Byte/version preflight and actual resource check; fresh output
Read saved initial J/U and verify identity; corrected codec/frame/tensor gates in fit env
Load unchanged original h/g/c and codec states in evaluation env; sparse physical sector400 and four independent sector assessments
Replay before-sector norms; sector operator equivalence and unchanged DF-budget preservation gates per rank
Save full/partial evidence, commit/push/remote verification, mandatory STOP

STOP.first_codec_identity_nonfinite_condition: Stop dependent work, drain started workers, preserve partial evidence; no fallback/tolerance change
STOP.DF_budget_fail: Record DF_BUDGET_NOT_PRESERVED and STOP; do not launch a fit or add ranks

qualification: Numerical pilot checks with existing allowances/engineering guard; not a rigorous enclosure, fit-convergence claim or total-resource superiority.
performance: Use existing resource_plan from actual affinity/quota/free memory for four independent sector assessments and coordinate process-local BLAS; sequential small Schur frames. No artificial CPU/RAM/wall cap, shared-environment changes or other-user interference.
permission_policy: Separate chat permission only; no approval record/certificate/new grant.
